nml_mods_list_description:
Here are your mods.
You can enable, disable or configure your mods.
NeoModLoader Update Complete:
NeoModLoader has been updated to version {0}.
Please restart the game to apply the update.
ModUploadMode_NoSteamIdPrompt:
No Steam Workshop ID found for this mod.

Please enter the Workshop ID in the upload window to update it.
ModUploadMode_WantToChange: Do you want to change anything?
ModUploadMode_AiWarning:
Are you sure?

If you used AI, you need to change the disclaimer before updating.
Clear Steam ID Confirm: Are you sure you want to clear the associated Steam Workshop ID?
AIDisclosure Hint: Steam Workshop requires accurate AI disclosure.
AIDisclosure Confirm Warning: Warning: Steam Workshop policy requires accurate AI disclosure.
AIDisclosure Confirm With Tag: This mod will be published with the '{0}' tag.
AIDisclosure Confirm Without Tag: This mod will be published without any AI tag.
AIDisclosure Confirm Removal Warning: Misrepresenting AI content may lead to mod removal by Workshop moderators.
ModLinkRequest: NeoModLoader will request for privilege to install BepInEx mods after you close this window.
FailedAutoUpdate:
Failed to update NeoModLoader
Please restart as Administrator
 If failed again
 Please update manually
 See How to install NeoModLoader manually
DiscordAuth Description:
Redirect to Discord to authenticate your account
Requires you having Modder role in Worldbox Discord channel
GithubAuth Description:
Redirect to Github to authenticate your account
Requires you to join WorldBoxOpenMods
WorldBoxOpenMods is an organization on Github
SkipAuth Description:
Skip authentication
Upload mod to 'Unverified Mod'
NeoModLoader Updated: NeoModLoader Updated, please restart the game.
ReloadMod Title:
Reload Mod
<color=red>DO NOT USE IT IF YOU ARE NOT DEVELOPER</color>
ModReload Title:
Reload Mod
<color=red>DO NOT USE IT IF YOU ARE NOT DEVELOPER</color>
NeoModLoader Report: Click to report bug or suggest new feature
mod_load_failed_description:
Failed to load mod
Click to disable it
Please check the mod is valid
ModManager Description: Enable, disable and configure your installed mods.
WorkshopMods Description: Load Workshop mods you subscribed to while the game was running.
mod_hub_filter_problems: Mods that failed to load or miss a required mod
mod_hub_sort_recentlychanged: Recently changed: last installed, updated or edited first
mod_hub_enable_all_confirm:
Enable {0} disabled mods?

They will be compiled and loaded the next time you start the game.
mod_hub_disable_all_confirm:
Disable all {0} enabled mods?

Mods that are loaded now stay active until you restart the game.
mod_hub_status_enabled_tip: Loaded and active. Click to disable it. It stays loaded until you restart the game.
mod_hub_status_disabled_tip: Not loaded. Click to enable it: NML compiles and loads it right away.
mod_hub_status_failed_tip: Enabled, but it failed to load. Click to disable it.
mod_hub_status_missingdependency_tip:
Enabled, but a mod it requires is not installed. Click to disable it.
Missing:
mod_hub_status_restartrequired_tip: Your change applies when you restart the game. Click to undo it.
mod_hub_reload: Reload mod (developer tool: recompiles and patches its code)
mod_hub_no_match: No mods match the filter or search.
